description:
Hintio is a desktop AI assistant for authorized questions, meetings and learning. Choose screen and audio context, add resume text or custom instructions, and review contextual AI-generated responses in an adjustable overlay.

Import PDF or DOCX context, review session history and export records. Choose speaker, microphone, combined or no-audio modes. Stop capture and withdraw cloud consent from the live session or privacy controls. Only capture and share material you are authorized to use.

AI responses may be inaccurate. Review important answers before relying on them. Report response by email prepares a draft: review and redact it before sending.

Free installation; a valid access token is required. Website trial access, when available, includes three sessions of up to 15 minutes each. Continued service access requires a paid plan. Internet is required for cloud sessions. India pricing: INR 2,049 per recurring monthly cycle (up to 120 cycles), or INR 14,000 prepaid for 365 days without automatic renewal. Cancel monthly renewal through Manage my billing on the Access page; the current paid period remains available. Paid access has no purchased session-count quota or fixed active-session duration. Service-protection limits apply, including 10,000 managed AI requests per rolling 24 hours; provider and network availability also apply. Review the final INR charge before authorizing payment.

The Store build encrypts local records using AES-256-GCM with a Windows-protected key. Exports may be unencrypted. Cloud processing is subject to provider terms. Updates are managed by Microsoft Store. Screen-sharing behavior depends on the capture tool; invisibility is not guaranteed.
features: Selectable speaker, microphone, combined and no-audio session modes

capabilityJustifications.runFullTrust: Electron desktop app uses normal user-level desktop window, global shortcut, screen/audio capture and native module APIs. It does not request administrator elevation.
capabilityJustifications.microphone: Captures microphone audio only in a user-selected microphone-enabled session mode.
capabilityJustifications.internetClient: Validates access tokens, sends selected context to configured AI providers and downloads optional local models.

reviewerRequirements: Supply working temporary access token privately in Partner Center certification notes
Keep backend reachable and provide adequate test credits
Explain screen/audio consent and each capture mode
Complete service pricing disclosure, age ratings and availability before submission
Complete live generative AI declaration and IARC questionnaire.
Provide a Store-identified package and verify Store-delivered behavior before release; browser component tests do not replace native tests.
Declare Razorpay as the secure third-party purchase/subscription API in Partner Center.
screenshotStatus: Five actual-component 1600x1000 PNG captures using test-only native bridges and synthetic content. Installed Store runtime unverified.
shortDescription: A desktop AI assistant with selected screen, audio and document context.

purchaseDisclosure.renewal: Monthly recurring, up to 120 cycles. Yearly prepaid for 365 days with manual renewal that retains remaining paid time.
purchaseDisclosure.cancellation: Authenticated Access page -> Manage my billing -> Cancel monthly renewal -> explicit end-of-cycle confirmation. Uninstalling does not cancel billing.
purchaseDisclosure.usageLimits: No purchased paid-session quota or fixed active-session duration. Service-protection limits: 40 chat requests/minute, 120 speech requests/minute, 180 total/minute and 10,000 total requests per rolling 24 hours per license. Provider/network availability applies.
purchaseDisclosure.entitlementIssue: Fixed with atomic license/token provisioning and an idempotent payment ledger. Two older records have no payment proof and are not automatically activated.
purchaseDisclosure.yearlyPriceSource: Live checkout policy and tested order request: 1400000 paise; no real charge performed
purchaseDisclosure.webhookStatus: Live and isolated Test-mode webhooks enabled; actual Test-mode purchase and renewal deliveries verified. Sandbox/live signing-secret separation is owner-deferred.
purchaseDisclosure.capturedPaymentTestEnvironment: Razorpay Test mode only; no real-money charge
purchaseDisclosure.trial: Website trial access, when available: three sessions, up to 15 minutes each. A valid trial token is required.
purchaseDisclosure.transactionProvider: Razorpay hosted checkout; app does not collect raw card numbers.

systemRequirements.internet: Required for cloud sessions and access validation

ownerDeferredSecurityActions: Historical OpenAI/Groq credential replacement and revocation
Separate live and sandbox Razorpay webhook signing secrets
